name: sync-origin-main-then-rebase
description: Keep the main repo stable on a timestamped personal snapshot, use a persistent worktree for the personal branch, sync Kevin main from nicobailon main, then rebase personal in the worktree.

phases.task:
Inspect repo/worktree state. Do not fetch, push, checkout, rebase, create branches, create worktrees, or edit files.

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
json_escape() { python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))'; }
repo="{args.repo}"
worktree_path="{args.worktreePath}"
origin_url_expected="{args.originUrl}"
main_branch="{args.mainBranch}"
personal_branch="{args.personalBranch}"
cd "$repo"
origin_url_actual="$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true)"
current_branch="$(git branch --show-current || true)"
head="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
status="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- . ':(exclude).pi/taskflows/runs' || true)"
worktree_status="missing"
worktree_branch=""
worktree_dirty=""
if [ -e "$worktree_path" ]; then
  if git -C "$worktree_path" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    worktree_status="exists"
    worktree_branch="$(git -C "$worktree_path" branch --show-current || true)"
    worktree_dirty="$(git -C "$worktree_path" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all || true)"
  else
    worktree_status="path exists but is not a git worktree"
  fi
fi
route="ready"
reason="ready"
case "$current_branch" in
  "$personal_branch"|"$personal_branch"-*) ;;&
  *) route="blocked"; reason="main repo must start on personal or personal-* branch" ;;&
esac
if [ -z "$current_branch" ]; then route="blocked"; reason="detached HEAD in main repo"; fi
if [ "$origin_url_actual" != "$origin_url_expected" ]; then route="blocked"; reason="origin URL mismatch"; fi
if ! git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$personal_branch"; then route="blocked"; reason="personal branch not found"; fi
if [ -n "$status" ]; then route="blocked"; reason="dirty main repo working tree"; fi
if [ "$worktree_status" = "path exists but is not a git worktree" ]; then route="blocked"; reason="worktree path exists but is not a git worktree"; fi
if [ "$worktree_status" = "exists" ] && [ "$worktree_branch" != "$personal_branch" ]; then route="blocked"; reason="existing worktree is not on personal branch"; fi
if [ "$worktree_status" = "exists" ] && [ -n "$worktree_dirty" ]; then route="blocked"; reason="dirty personal worktree"; fi
printf '{"route":%s,"reason":%s,"repo":%s,"worktreePath":%s,"currentBranch":%s,"personalBranch":%s,"mainBranch":%s,"originUrl":%s,"head":%s,"status":%s,"worktreeStatus":%s,"worktreeBranch":%s,"worktreeDirty":%s}
' \
  "$(printf '%s' "$route" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$reason" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$repo" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_path" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$current_branch" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$personal_branch" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$main_branch" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$origin_url_actual" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$head" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$status" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_status" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_branch" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_dirty" | json_escape)"
```

Output ONLY JSON.

Preflight blocked safe sync/rebase. Explain blocker briefly and end with VERDICT: BLOCK.

Preflight:
{steps.preflight.output}

End with exactly one verdict line: VERDICT: BLOCK

Put the main repo on a stable timestamped snapshot branch if it is currently on personal. Do not fetch, push, or rebase.

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
json_escape() { python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))'; }
repo="{args.repo}"
personal_branch="{args.personalBranch}"
cd "$repo"
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- . ':(exclude).pi/taskflows/runs')" ]
current_branch="$(git branch --show-current)"
if [ "$current_branch" = "$personal_branch" ]; then
  stable_branch="$personal_branch-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
  git branch "$stable_branch" HEAD
  git checkout "$stable_branch"
else
  stable_branch="$current_branch"
fi
printf '{"route":"done","stableBranch":%s,"currentBranch":%s,"head":%s}
' \
  "$(printf '%s' "$stable_branch" | json_escape)" \
  "$(git branch --show-current | json_escape)" \
  "$(git rev-parse HEAD | json_escape)"
```

Output ONLY JSON.

Ensure persistent worktree exists at {args.worktreePath} and is checked out on {args.personalBranch}. Main repo must remain on stable branch. Do not fetch, push, or rebase.

Stabilize output:
{steps.stabilize-main-repo.output}

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
json_escape() { python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))'; }
repo="{args.repo}"
worktree_path="{args.worktreePath}"
personal_branch="{args.personalBranch}"
cd "$repo"
[ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "$personal_branch" ]
if [ -e "$worktree_path" ]; then
  git -C "$worktree_path" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null
else
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$worktree_path")"
  git worktree add "$worktree_path" "$personal_branch"
fi
branch="$(git -C "$worktree_path" branch --show-current)"
[ "$branch" = "$personal_branch" ]
[ -z "$(git -C "$worktree_path" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]
printf '{"route":"done","worktreePath":%s,"worktreeBranch":%s,"worktreeHead":%s,"mainRepoBranch":%s}
' \
  "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_path" | json_escape)" \
  "$(printf '%s' "$branch" | json_escape)" \
  "$(git -C "$worktree_path" rev-parse HEAD | json_escape)" \
  "$(git branch --show-current | json_escape)"
```

Output ONLY JSON.

Fetch nicobailon/{args.mainBranch} into upstream tracking ref. Do not push. Do not rebase.

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
repo="{args.repo}"
upstream_url="{args.upstreamUrl}"
main_branch="{args.mainBranch}"
cd "$repo"
git fetch "$upstream_url" "refs/heads/$main_branch:refs/remotes/upstream/$main_branch"
printf 'UPSTREAM_MAIN_FETCHED\nupstream_url=%s\nupstream_ref=refs/remotes/upstream/%s\nupstream_head=%s\nmain_repo_branch=%s\n' \
  "$upstream_url" "$main_branch" "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/upstream/$main_branch)" "$(git branch --show-current)"
```

Report exact stdout/stderr. Do not push.

Move local {args.mainBranch} branch to fetched upstream/{args.mainBranch}. It must not be checked out. Do not push.

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
repo="{args.repo}"
main_branch="{args.mainBranch}"
personal_branch="{args.personalBranch}"
cd "$repo"
[ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "$main_branch" ]
[ "$(git -C "{args.worktreePath}" branch --show-current)" = "$personal_branch" ]
git branch -f "$main_branch" "refs/remotes/upstream/$main_branch"
printf 'LOCAL_MAIN_UPDATED\nmain_branch=%s\nmain_head=%s\nmain_repo_branch=%s\nworktree_branch=%s\n' \
  "$main_branch" "$(git rev-parse refs/heads/$main_branch)" "$(git branch --show-current)" "$(git -C "{args.worktreePath}" branch --show-current)"
```

Report exact stdout/stderr. Do not push.

Approve pushing local {args.mainBranch} (now synced to nicobailon/{args.mainBranch}) to Kevin origin {args.mainBranch} at {args.originUrl}.

Reject stops the flow; no personal rebase will be attempted.

Update output:
{steps.update-local-main.output}

User approved. Push local {args.mainBranch} to Kevin origin {args.mainBranch}. Do not push personal branch.

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
repo="{args.repo}"
main_branch="{args.mainBranch}"
origin_url_expected="{args.originUrl}"
cd "$repo"
[ "$(git remote get-url origin)" = "$origin_url_expected" ]
git push origin "refs/heads/$main_branch:refs/heads/$main_branch"
git fetch origin "refs/heads/$main_branch:refs/remotes/origin/$main_branch"
printf 'ORIGIN_MAIN_PUSHED\nremote=%s\nbranch=%s\norigin_main_head=%s\nmain_repo_branch=%s\n' \
  "$origin_url_expected" "$main_branch" "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/$main_branch)" "$(git branch --show-current)"
```

Report exact stdout/stderr. Do not push anything else.

In persistent worktree only, create backup branch and attempt rebase of {args.personalBranch} onto origin/{args.mainBranch}. If conflicts/failure, abort to restore original branch before asking permission for conflict edits. Main repo must stay on stable branch. Do not push personal branch.

Worktree setup:
{steps.ensure-personal-worktree.output}

Run:
```bash
set -euo pipefail
json_escape() { python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read()))'; }
repo="{args.repo}"
worktree_path="{args.worktreePath}"
main_branch="{args.mainBranch}"
personal_branch="{args.personalBranch}"
[ "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)" != "$personal_branch" ]
[ "$(git -C "$worktree_path" branch --show-current)" = "$personal_branch" ]
if [ -n "$(git -C "$worktree_path" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" ]; then
  status="$(git -C "$worktree_path" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
  printf '{"route":"ask","reason":"dirty personal worktree before rebase","personalBranch":%s,"status":%s}
' \
    "$(printf '%s' "$personal_branch" | json_escape)" "$(printf '%s' "$status" | json_escape)"
  exit 0
fi
backup="backup/pre-origin-main-rebase-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$personal_branch"
git -C "$worktree_path" branch "$backup" HEAD
set +e
git -C "$worktree_path" rebase "refs/remotes/origin/$main_branch" >/tmp/pi-worktree-rebase.log 2>&1
code=$?
set -e
log="$(tail -120 /tmp/pi-worktree-rebase.log || true)"
if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then
  printf '{"route":"done","reason":"rebase succeeded","personalBranch":%s,"backup":%s,"onto":%s,"worktreePath":%s,"mainRepoBranch":%s,"head":%s,"log":%s}
' \
    "$(printf '%s' "$personal_branch" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$backup" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "refs/remotes/origin/$main_branch" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_path" | json_escape)" \
    "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current | json_escape)" \
    "$(git -C "$worktree_path" rev-parse HEAD | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$log" | json_escape)"
else
  git -C "$worktree_path" rebase --abort >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '{"route":"ask","reason":"worktree rebase failed; aborted to original branch","personalBranch":%s,"backup":%s,"onto":%s,"worktreePath":%s,"exitCode":%s,"log":%s}
' \
    "$(printf '%s' "$personal_branch" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$backup" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "refs/remotes/origin/$main_branch" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$worktree_path" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$code" | json_escape)" \
    "$(printf '%s' "$log" | json_escape)"
fi
```
